meta.titol: Tecnibike · Bike rental and workshop on the Costa Brava
meta.descripcio: Rent road, gravel, mountain and electric bikes in Sant Antoni de Calonge, or book a workshop appointment. Cannondale, Scott, Specialized, Pinarello and Colnago.

mostra.nota: Data marked with * is sample data and must be confirmed with Tecnibike.

portada.situacio: Sant Antoni de Calonge · Costa Brava
portada.subtitol: High-end bikes from our shop, by the day or by the hour, and a workshop that keeps yours in shape. Book in two minutes, in your language.

anatomia.sr: A red road bike in a workshop comes apart piece by piece: wheels, brakes, drivetrain, handlebar, saddle and finally the bare frame.

rodes.qualitat: Mid-depth carbon wheels with tubeless tyres: less weight, more grip and goodbye to small punctures.

frens.qualitat: Hydraulic disc brakes: strong, consistent braking in the dry or the wet, with two fingers.

transmissio.qualitat: 12-speed groupset with crisp shifts first time, even climbing and under load.

direccio.qualitat: Carbon bar and stem with integrated cables: stiff, light and clean.

seient.qualitat: Cut-out saddle and carbon seatpost: comfort and a good position on long rides.

quadre.qualitat: Monocoque carbon frame: stiff where you push and compliant where it needs to absorb. The heart of the bike.

flota.intro: Bikes from our own shop, checked after every rental. The more days you keep it, the lower the price.

tarifes.nota: Price per bike per day. Helmet included*.

u.text: We tell you which size fits your height, and you choose your pedals.

dos.text: You see the full price instantly, no surprises, and book in two minutes.

tres.text: At the shop we set it up for you. Your helmet will be ready.

taller.intro: Over 15 years repairing road, mountain and electric bikes. Book a slot, drop it off, and we'll message you on WhatsApp when it's ready.

avantatges.pressupost: A quote before we touch anything

rutes.intro: Three real routes starting from the shop, with their true track, distance and climbing. If you like, one of our guides will show you the way.
rutes.errorMapa: The map couldn't load. The route details are alongside.
rutes.font: Track calculated with BRouter on OpenStreetMap data.

gavarres.text: Through Calonge, the climb to Romanyà de la Selva among cork oaks and the descent via Santa Cristina d'Aro down to the beach.

fitor.text: Tracks through cork oaks and pines via Vall-llobrega and Santa Coloma de Fitor, back through Sant Cebrià dels Alls.

arques.text: Up to the top of the Gavarres, over 500 metres high, on forest tracks and singletrack, with views across the Empordà.

rutes.titol: The Costa Brava is the best gym.

equipament.titol: Clothing, helmets and everything you wear.
equipament.text: Try it on in the shop: we find your size, fit your helmet and tell you which nutrition suits the ride you are planning.

cascs.text: Light, well ventilated and with MIPS. We fit it for you on the spot.

ulleres.text: Photochromic and contrast lenses for the Costa Brava sun.

roba.text: Technical jerseys, bib shorts and gilets for summer and winter.

sabates.text: Road and mountain, with the cleats fitted and adjusted.

nutricio.text: Gels, bars and drinks so you never run empty halfway up a climb.

accessoris.text: Bottles, lights, maintenance, tubeless sealant and bike racks.

talla.p: How do I know my size?
talla.r: When you book we ask your height and suggest a size. At the shop we fine-tune saddle height and handlebar position.

pedals.p: Can I bring my own pedals?
pedals.r: Of course. We also have flat, Shimano SPD, SPD-SL and Look pedals so you don't have to pack yours.

fianca.r: We ask for an ID card or passport and a card deposit, refunded when you return the bike*.

cancel.r: Yes, free of charge up to 48 hours before collection*.

hotel.p: Do you deliver to my hotel?
hotel.r: We deliver to hotels in Calonge, Platja d'Aro and Palamós for two bikes or more*.

taller.p: How long does the workshop take?
taller.r: A service or a puncture is usually same day or next day. We give you the turnaround when you drop it off and message you on WhatsApp.

peu.lema: Bike rental, workshop and shop on the Costa Brava for over 15 years.
